verify.note: Closes when no PROG-CAL row still string-matches a source file for an identifier, in EITHER form. Scope stays PROG-CAL on purpose (see detail): that is the corpus the failure was found in, and a repo-wide ban is a larger ruling that should be made deliberately rather than smuggled in here.
